Hi Alyssa / Jonas,

Thanks for the details and the screenshot. I pulled the provisioning logs and found that the promo application failed due to a mismatch between the signup path (invite-based vs public-PLG) — the coupon is scoped to public PLG signups only. It looks like Verdant was routed through an invite link which bypasses the automatic promo hook.

Options:
1) I can manually grant the $500 credit to your account today (will appear in the wallet within ~10 minutes).
2) Engineering can patch the routing logic so invite signups pick up public promos (ETA 2-3 business days).

If you’re ok with option 1 I just need a confirmation that we should apply: 
- Amount: $500 promotional credit
- Promo code to reference: REDWOOD-PLG-500
- Apply to account: signup email alyssa.cho@verdanthealth.com

I attached the standard promo terms for record-keeping.

Laura Bennett
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
